# Entries permitted at the repository root -- files and directories alike, one
# per line, no trailing slash on directories.
#
# Every entry here is deliberate. The root is where scratch artefacts land,
# because `git add -A` in a worktree you have been working in does not care
# what a file is for, and a one-line addition at the root is invisible in a
# large diff. Six have reached `main` this way. The list was built by walking
# every root path ever added on main and subtracting the ones still here, not
# by collecting the ones somebody reported:
#
#   .msg.txt      39675330b, ~1.5h on main
#   .wa64.log     83a51bfa6, ~17h
#   .commitmsg/   faedea4d1, ~3m -- a DIRECTORY (.commitmsg/m.txt)
#   .commitmsg    #1881, ~37h, removed by #1999
#   .pris_v4.log  #1951, 1364-line cargo transcript, removed by #1975
#   .body.md      #2026, PR body, removed by #2036
#
# Each was repaired by adding one more pattern to .gitignore, and each time the
# next one was named outside every pattern. .body.md landed *after* two such
# fixes, hours after both, and the name it should have had (.pr-body.md) was
# already ignored. Enumerating what belongs is the only form of this check that
# does not need to predict the next name.
#
# Directories are listed because .commitmsg/ is one of the six, and a check that
# compares only files cannot see it: `.commitmsg/m.txt` contains a separator, so
# a files-only filter discards it as "not at the root". #2036 shipped that gap
# while citing that very instance in its own header.
#
# To add a root entry legitimately: add it here in the same PR. That is the
# escape hatch, and unlike a label it leaves a permanent record of the decision.
